title: Arrivals and Departures
bookshelves: Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: This book explores the human relationship with changing biodiversity. New animal and plant species arrive, and the ones previously existing may disappear. However, the historical and social perspectives of the matter have been understudied so far. The authors provide fresh insights into human-nature relations and explain why we need multidisciplinary approaches in order to fully understand their complexity.
